# ABC7 Los Angeles

> > ABC7 Los Angeles (KABC-TV) is Southern California's leading local news station, delivering breaking news, weather, traffic, and entertainment coverage across Los Angeles, Orange, Ventura, and San Bernardino counties.

ABC7 Los Angeles provides comprehensive local and national news coverage with a focus on Southern California communities, including bilingual Spanish-language reporting. As part of the ABC News network and Disney family, the station covers everything from breaking news and public safety to entertainment, weather events, and community issues.

## Key Topics

- Southern California local news
- Los Angeles breaking news
- KABC-TV coverage
- Ventura County news
- San Bernardino County news
- Entertainment and Oscars coverage
- Public safety and law enforcement
- Weather and natural events
- Bilingual Spanish news reporting
- ABC News network content
- Community issues and investigations
- Traffic and transportation
- Celebrity and entertainment news
- National security alerts
